name: Hungary: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or sponsor are left empty, not invented.
Language matches requirements.json language_rules (Hungarian; cover letter and document list always Hungarian).

Signatures as the Hungary rules require at submission: protocol signature pages signed by the PI and co-investigators; every signature or declaration field of the CV, DoI and site-suitability templates completed and no national field removed; insurance evidence authenticated as the issuing document requires.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json; personal names only for the principal investigator in M1 and M2.
Version and date match the Hungarian cover letter and Part II document list.

HU-K1.check: Uses the EU recruitment and informed-consent procedure template v2.0 (or another NNGYK-accepted format) and contains the Hungarian national content either way.

Yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each 'yes' section completed, each 'no' section gives the not-applicable answer.

Member State fields carry the Hungarian rules: final Hungarian recruitment material; one combined information and consent document with one signature set; participant name, place and date of birth and no study code; separate genetic consent; renewed consent for non-anonymous secondary use.
Incapacitated adults: Section 16 Health Act authorised person and identity details, participant's opinion considered, refusal respected, re-consent when capacity is regained.
Minors: Section 16 authorised person, age- and maturity-appropriate information, minor's opinion and dissent, age-16 rule not treated as independent trial consent, re-consent at adulthood.
Two witnesses not interested in or participating in the research, with address or contact; oral consent in their simultaneous presence; written confirmation if writing ability returns.
Emergency: all Section 160 Health Act conditions and Article 35 CTR, documentation of the emergency criteria, later information and consent of the participant or authorised person.
Recruitment routes match the recruitment material (HU-K2) and the protocol.

HU-M1.check: One CV per principal investigator and per co-investigator at each Hungarian site, on the ETT-KFEB Hungary-adapted CTEG template (not the generic EU form).
Every signature or declaration field of the template completed; no national field removed.
GCP qualification fully documented in the CV, or a separate certificate present (HU-M-GCP).
Co-investigator CVs carry no personal name in the CTIS title.

HU-M2-DOI.check: One declaration per principal investigator and site on the EudraLex structure; the assistant filled only trial title and EU trial number.
Declaration fields (investigator name, institution, date) completed by the investigator; no field removed.

HU-M-GCP.check: GCP qualification evidenced for each investigator concerned, either by a full reference in the CV (accepted per MedEthicsEU) or by a current certificate.

HU-M-PROTOCOL-SIGNATURE.check: Signature or acceptance pages for the protocol version in the application, signed by the principal investigator and every co-investigator of the site.
Protocol version and date on the pages match Part I and the Hungarian document list.
A redacted public version is planned if the document is publishable (signatures and personal data).

HU-N1.check: One form per Hungarian site on the current ETT-KFEB Hungary-modified Site Suitability Form (November 2025 version), not the generic EU form.
Site-specific information demonstrates appropriate facilities and resources and is consistent with the protocol procedures, IMP handling and planned participant numbers.
Every signature or declaration field completed; no national field removed.

HU-O1.check: Insurance confirmation or certificate covers the trial (identifies it) and Hungary.
Signature or authentication as the issuing document requires.
Insurer name, Hungarian contact, contact person and telephone number match every participant document.

HU-O2.check: Insurance policy present and consistent with the certificate; cover, exclusions and participant obligations match the participant documents.

HU-P1.check: States explicitly whether compensation or reimbursement is offered; amounts, cost types and conditions identical to the participant documents.
Only documented expenses reimbursed, listed by exact cost type; no 'may reimburse' wording.
Participation payment only within the Bioethics Code (Phase I, non-therapeutic PK or PD); none for minors or incapacitated persons.
List of small-value gifts or retention items with the commercial value of each item.
Third-party reimbursement service arrangement, data transferred and fees described consistently with the consent material.

HU-P2.check: Full amount of compensation per participant to the site and to the principal investigator and team, and its distribution, for each Hungarian site.

HU-COVER.check: Hungarian-language cover letter lists every document submitted for approval with name, version number and issue date.
For a substantial modification: modified and newly created documents identified with version and date; clean and tracked-change versions provided where applicable.

HU-DOC-LIST.check: Hungarian list of the Part II documents present, with versions and dates identical to the cover letter, the uploads and the participant document footers.
